plans.note: No standalone limitation-of-liability heading appears in the outline; caps and disclaimers are commonly embedded in the indemnity section (sec-12) or in the warranty/covenant provisions (sec-8). Note the outline skips sections 3, 4, 6, 9 and 11, so a liability clause may sit in an unlisted section — confirm before concluding it is missing. Check mutuality, cap amount and carve-outs (confidentiality, IP infringement, gross negligence).

Primary read is sec-12 (INDEMNITY). Confirm TrueLink indemnifies us for third-party IP claims arising from the licensed software and Hosting Services and for its own misconduct; check whether the indemnity runs only from Client (one-way), in which case sec-8 covenants may reinforce our exposure. Client-side indemnity should stay narrow (our content/data, our breach).

Scan sec-2 (LICENSE) for use restrictions that function as a covenant not to operate competing services, and sec-8 (Client covenants) for restrictions on our lines of business. No non-compete heading appears; likely absent unless buried in sec-8.

Check sec-2 for an exclusive-hosting or sole-provider grant and sec-8 for a covenant to route all mortgage web traffic through TrueLink; sec-5 may tie compensation to exclusivity. No exclusivity heading in the outline.

Pricing terms sit in sec-5 (COMPENSATION); look for any obligation that we offer TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to other hosts or partners. An MFN in our favour is welcome and should not be flagged.

Most likely location is sec-8 (Client covenants) or as a tail provision in sec-10 (CONFIDENTIALITY). If present, check duration, scope (employees who worked on the engagement only) and a general-advertising/unsolicited-response carve-out.

No term/termination heading is listed; the outline omits sections 3, 4, 6, 9 and 11, which is the probable home for term and termination. Within the supplied sections, sec-5 may contain early-termination fees or penalties. Verify we may terminate on notice without penalty and that TrueLink cannot terminate for convenience mid-term.

Auto-renewal mechanics usually sit with term (unlisted sections) with price uplift language in sec-5. Check renewal length, non-renewal notice window (target 30 days or less) and any uncapped price increase.

No general/miscellaneous or dispute-resolution section appears in the outline. Governing law and venue are most likely in an unlisted trailing section; confirm against the full document before treating as missing. Accepted: NY, DE, CA, England and Wales, with courts rather than foreign arbitration.

No assignment heading in the supplied outline; check unlisted trailing sections. We need the right to assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger or asset sale, and TrueLink must not gain a termination right on our change of control.

sec-2 (LICENSE) plus the sec-1 definitions of the licensed materials and Hosting Services govern ownership; sec-10 may address ownership of information disclosed. Confirm we retain ownership of our content, customer/borrower data and marks, that TrueLink takes no licence beyond hosting delivery, and that no feedback or data assignment runs to TrueLink.

sec-2 is the grant; read with defined terms in sec-1. Test scope (affiliates and contractors permitted to use), territory, sublicensing to end users of our web site, and whether the grant is revocable at will or terminable only for material breach.

Usage/records audit rights, if any, would appear in sec-8 (Client covenants) or alongside fee verification in sec-5. If present, check frequency, advance notice, business-hours limit, confidentiality and that TrueLink bears cost absent material underpayment.

Check sec-5 for stipulated damages, penalty interest or fixed per-incident charges against us, and sec-7 (UNSOLICITED COMMERCIAL E-MAIL) for per-message penalties or fixed sums payable by Client, which is a common spam-clause pattern. Service credits payable to us are welcome and not flagged.

sec-8 covers warranties of Client only, so a TrueLink performance warranty is not visible in the outline and may sit in an unlisted section (3, 4, 6, 9 or 11) with the Hosting Services obligations. Confirm there is a vendor warranty of conforming performance for a meaningful period with a repair/re-perform or refund remedy, and check sec-2/sec-8 for an 'as is' disclaimer.

No insurance heading in the outline. Since TrueLink hosts our site and handles user data, we expect commercial general liability, professional/E&O and cyber cover; check unlisted sections and sec-12 (indemnity often paired with insurance) before recording as missing.

sec-5 (COMPENSATION) is the likely home for minimum monthly fees, guaranteed volumes or take-or-pay commitments; sec-2 may cap licensed seats or transaction volumes. Confirm any minimum is matched by a termination right or true-up rather than an unconditional payment obligation.

No termination-consequences or transition heading appears; sec-10 may include a return-or-destroy obligation for confidential information, which is the closest analogue. Verify whether we obtain return of our data in usable format and reasonable migration assistance post-termination; check unlisted sections before recording as missing.
